name: Molnaszecsőd (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, yellow at the hoist and green at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Molnaszecsőd: a yellow and green shield with a mill, a flower and a bridge, inscribed MOLNASZECSŐD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
